beats.text: Sabi ng kakilala ni Demi, pare-pareho raw at awtomatiko ang allowance ng lahat ng BHW. Nagtanong siya: anong benepisyo, at anong kondisyon?

Anim ang kategorya: hazard at subsistence allowance; training, education at career enrichment; civil service eligibility; libreng legal services; at preferential access sa loans para sa organisadong grupo.
Kailangan ang rehistrasyon kung saan naglilingkod. Saklaw ang akreditadong BHW na aktibo at regular ang tungkulin. May kondisyon pa ang bawat benepisyo at review kapag lokal ang pondo.
Hazard: exposure sa panganib na validated ng tamang awtoridad. Subsistence: serbisyo sa isolated station para available anumang oras. Magkaiba ang kondisyon; huwag mag-imbento ng halaga.
Tanong ni Demi sa RHU: sino ang tamang contact para matiyak ang katayuan, ebidensiya, validation at lokal na approval? Tanong pa lamang ito; hindi pa alam ang kaniyang entitlement.
Ipaliwanag ang benepisyo at kondisyon, saka piliin ang verification. Walang pangakong awtomatikong bayad at walang pagsisi sa hindi nakatanggap. Magsanay gamit ang kathang-isip na kaso.
Demi hears that every BHW gets the same allowance automatically. She asks: which benefit, and which conditions?
Six categories: hazard and subsistence allowances; training, education and career enrichment; civil service eligibility; free legal services; and preferential loan access for organized groups.
Registration where service is rendered is required. The Act covers accredited BHWs actively and regularly performing duties. Each benefit has conditions, with board review when local funds are used.
Hazard: risk exposure validated by proper authorities. Subsistence: service within an isolated station for availability at all times. Different conditions; do not invent an amount.
Demi asks the RHU: who can help verify status, evidence, validation and local approval? This is only a question; her entitlement remains unverified.
Explain the benefit and conditions, then choose verification. Promise no automatic payment and do not blame non-recipients. Practice with a fictional case.
